OUR MEDICAL SERVICES (12)

Personalised primary healthcare for your whole family.

Explore our full range of medical services provided by Dr. Michael Le Roux, Dr. Danielle Strydom, and Dr. Rhiyaan Smith.

Primary Healthcare

Preventive care and medical consultations for acute and chronic conditions, offering personalised, holistic healthcare to promote overall well-being.

  • Acute & chronic condition consultations
  • Preventive health & lifestyle guidance
  • Personalised, holistic medical care

IV Therapy

Direct intravenous infusion of essential vitamins and nutrients to support hydration, boost energy levels, and promote overall wellness.

  • Direct vitamin & nutrient replenishment
  • Rapid hydration & energy support
  • Doctor-screened clinical infusions

Family Medicine Specialist

Comprehensive, patient-centred specialist care across all ages, including ongoing prescriptions for timely access to the treatments you need.

  • Specialist care for children, adults & seniors
  • Complex chronic disease management
  • Timely prescriptions & repeat scripts

Medical Checkup

Comprehensive medical check-ups and routine wellness evaluations to ensure your long-term health remains our top priority.

  • Full physical & vital signs examination
  • Blood pressure, glucose & cholesterol checks
  • Early detection & preventive screenings

Wound Care

Experienced clinical wound management and sterile dressings ensuring optimal tissue healing and preventing complications.

  • Acute & post-surgical wound dressings
  • Burn care & chronic ulcer management
  • Infection prevention & suture removal

Blood Tests

Convenient in-practice diagnostic and monitoring blood tests to accurately investigate and track a wide range of medical conditions.

  • Diagnostic pathology & blood profiles
  • Chronic medication & organ monitoring
  • Clear doctor review of all lab results

Palliative Care

Compassionate, qualified palliative support focused on comfort, dignity, and enhancing quality of life for serious and life-limiting illnesses.

  • Symptom & pain management support
  • Holistic patient & family guidance
  • Dignified, compassionate ongoing care

Aesthetic Treatments

Safe, effective doctor-led aesthetic treatments designed to enhance natural beauty, restore confidence, and promote healthy, radiant skin.

  • Personalised skin & aesthetic consultations
  • Safe, medical-grade skin rejuvenation
  • Natural-looking results & skin health

Home Visits

Dedicated home consultations to ensure medical accessibility, comfort, and convenience for patients unable to visit the practice in person.

  • Home medical assessments in Kuils River
  • Ideal for elderly or mobility-impaired patients
  • Continuity of care in the comfort of home

Sonography Services

Reassuring ultrasound guidance and clinical support during pregnancy, addressing your questions and providing attentive antenatal care.

  • Pregnancy ultrasound & antenatal support
  • Clear explanation of findings for parents
  • Compassionate maternal & fetal monitoring

Mental Health Services

Compassionate, confidential medical support and care for mental health concerns, stress, anxiety, and emotional well-being.

  • Supportive, non-judgmental consultations
  • Anxiety, mood & burnout management
  • Holistic care for mind and body

Small Medical Services

Convenient, professional minor medical procedures performed safely in our clinic to support your everyday health needs and wellbeing.

  • Minor in-clinic surgical procedures
  • Skin lesion removals, suturing & dressings
  • Safe, sterile treatment without hospital stay
